churches.assessment: All Souls Anglican Church is an ACNA parish in the Anglican Diocese of the South, serving Atlanta with a Sunday 4:15 PM service at 1950 Bolton Road (northwest Atlanta). Rector Rev. Collin Setterberg leads the congregation, which self-describes as 'a deeply-rooted, grace-filled Anglican parish' with three core values: pursuing beauty in Christ, practicing presence through weekly communion and prayer, and participating in spiritual restoration. The Anglican Diocese of the South was created on June 9, 2010 and is headquartered in Atlanta; All Souls is one of its orthodox parishes. ACNA 39 Articles framework with male-only ordination aligns with MOOP's biblical-design rubric. Green-rated Anglican option for the Atlanta metro.
churches.denomination_detail: ACNA — Anglican Diocese of the South; planted 2020-2022 out of Village Church at Vinings
churches.enrichment_notes: Solid ACNA/DOTS parish; female deacon present but no female priests. Diocese of the South is one of ACNA's more confessional, male-only-priesthood dioceses.

churches.assessment: First Methodist Church of Douglas is a South Georgia congregation that disaffiliated from the UMC and joined the GMC in May 2023. Pastor Paul Elliott leads the church, supported by Hayden Morris (Assistant Pastor/Youth Director), Jaime Anderson (Children's Director/Preschool Director), and other staff. As a recently-transitioned GMC church, the institutional commitment to orthodox Wesleyan teaching is strong — leaving the UMC carried real costs. Staff depth includes active children's and youth ministry plus a preschool program. The GMC South Georgia Conference stance on women elders should be verified. Overall a credible orthodox Wesleyan option in rural South Georgia.

churches.assessment: Maranatha Baptist Church in Plains, Georgia is the small-town Baptist congregation where President Jimmy Carter taught Sunday school for nearly four decades — from 1981 until his health declined in 2019. The church drew international visitors who came specifically to hear Carter teach; he funeralized there in January 2025. Rev. Tony Lowden was Carter's personal pastor and the first Black lead pastor, succeeded by Rev. Ashley Guthas in 2024 — the church's first woman pastor (a divorced mother of two). In March 2025 under Guthas the church removed American flags from the sanctuary. Maranatha is independent / CBF-aligned (Cooperative Baptist Fellowship, formed 1991 by ex-SBC moderates over biblical-inerrancy and women-in-ministry questions). Carter himself publicly broke with the SBC over its 2000 BFM revision restricting women from senior pastor roles. Per MOOP rubric the female-senior-pastor + CBF-progressive denominational posture is RED on gender / leadership; included for situational awareness about the most famous lay-led Bible-teaching church in America under Carter.
churches.denomination_detail: Independent Baptist; CBF-aligned (Cooperative Baptist Fellowship); broke with SBC trajectory under Carter.
churches.gender_detail: Female senior pastor since 2024 (Rev. Ashley Guthas, first woman pastor in the congregation's history).
churches.enrichment_notes: Live-fetched https://mbcplains.org/ + Christian Post + Word&Way + AJC + WGXA + Today.com coverage on 2026-05-16 — confirmed Rev. Ashley Guthas as senior pastor since 2024 (first woman pastor; divorced mother of two) + Carter's nearly-four-decade Sunday school teaching 1981-2019 + Carter funeral held at Maranatha January 2025 + Tony Lowden as Carter's personal pastor before Guthas + March 2025 sanctuary flag removal under Guthas.

churches.assessment: Mt. Bethel Church Marietta GA is one of the most prominent post-UMC independent megachurches. Senior Pastor Dr. Jody Ray (since 2016) was reassigned by UMC Bishop Sue Haupert-Johnson in 2021; he surrendered his UMC clergy credentials in protest, the congregation gathered ~4,700 signatures, and the church ultimately paid ~$13.1M in a 2022 settlement to leave the UMC with property. Importantly, Mt. Bethel did NOT join the GMC — it operates as an independent Methodist congregation. ~10,000 members, 2,300+ avg attendance. The pastor's and congregation's deliberate stand against UMC progressive leadership is theologically substantive. Yellow denominational reflects post-schism independence with no connectional accountability — the autonomy is sometimes a weakness, sometimes a strength.

churches.assessment: Andy Stanley is arguably the most influential — and most concerning — megachurch pastor in America. He holds a DTS MDiv and is Charles Stanley's son, so he knows orthodox theology. His deliberate departure from it is therefore more troubling, not less. Stanley has told Christians to 'unhitch' from the Old Testament, avoided the word 'inerrant,' and in 2023 his church hosted events acknowledging same-sex couples. score_notes.soteriology: Gospel is preached. Salvation by grace through faith affirmed.
score_notes.cultural: Giglio has made culturally accommodating statements. In 2020 he used the phrase 'white blessing' when discussing racial issues, suggesting some cultural drift.
score_notes.preaching: Topical/motivational. Giglio is a gifted communicator but not an expository preacher. Conference-style energy.

churches.assessment: Passion City Church and Louie Giglio's broader Passion movement have done genuine good in mobilizing young adults for worship and anti-trafficking causes. Giglio has shown some cultural accommodation tendencies and the ministry lacks the doctrinal precision and male-headship emphasis that MOOP values. Not a bad church, but not a GREEN church either. YELLOW — good entry point for young believers but needs stronger expository and patriarchal commitments.

churches.assessment: Ebenezer Baptist in Atlanta is MLK's home church, now pastored by U.S. Senator Raphael Warnock — whose PhD work at Union Seminary was explicit Black liberation theology and whose public theology affirms abortion rights and LGBTQ inclusion. churches.assessment: Vineville Baptist Church (Macon GA) is a moderate-Baptist congregation dual-aligned with the Georgia Baptist Mission Board (SBC) and the Cooperative Baptist Fellowship of Georgia. Senior Pastor Rev. Greg Pope is male, but two of the four pastoral-track positions on the church's staff page are filled by ordained women bearing the title 'Rev.': Rev. Angela Blizzard (Minister of Music, on staff since 2007) and Rev. Leigh Halverson (Minister of Family Life and Education). The church's children's ministry uses CBF curriculum. While the staff use 'Minister' rather than 'Pastor' in formal titling, the practice of ordaining women to staff ministry sits in direct tension with BF&M 2000 Article VI as the SBC currently interprets it.
churches.gender_detail: Minister of Music: Rev. Angela Blizzard (female, ordained, on staff since 2007). Minister of Family Life and Education: Rev. Leigh Halverson (female, ordained). Both carry 'Rev.' honorific indicating ordained pastoral status under moderate-Baptist polity.
churches.denomination_detail: Listed in SBC.net Churches Directory as 'Vineville Baptist Church (Inc).' Also listed on the Cooperative Baptist Fellowship of Georgia churches roster. Dual-aligned SBC (GBMB) / CBF.
churches.enrichment_notes: Distinct from the existing 'First Baptist Church Macon' and 'First Baptist Church Macon GA' records (both are at 511 High Pl). Vineville is at 2591 Vineville Ave.
